description.zh: 连接课程生成服务后，可上传资料、生成大纲与整门课、导出交付包。
description.en: Connect to CourseGenie to upload sources, build a full course and export a delivery package.

title.zh: 配置课程生成器访问令牌

description.zh: 粘贴服务方提供的访问令牌。令牌只保存在本机，用于调用课程生成服务。
description.en: Paste the access token provided by the CourseGenie operator. It is stored locally and used only to call the course service.

docLabel.en: How to get an access token?

placeholder.zh: 粘贴课程生成器访问令牌

description.zh: 会写入 Authorization: Bearer 请求头；不随课程资料上传，也不写入日志。
description.en: Sent as the Authorization: Bearer header; never uploaded with course materials or written to logs.
